title: Two-scalar-field $f(R)$ Thick Branes, Gravitational Resonances and Quasinormal Modes
summary: In this paper, we investigate thick brane worlds in $f(R)$ gravity supported by two-scalar-field. The two-scalar sector provides an analytical warped background with tunable energy-density splitting, allowing us to test whether a Bloch-type internal structure can generate long-lived tensor perturbations resonances in the physically admissible region. We impose the positivity of \(f_R\equiv df/dR\), the derivative of the gravitational Lagrangian with respect to the Ricci scalar, which plays the role of an effective gravitational coupling in \(f(R)\) gravity.
